Of the same62 labels, bidirectional-average Dice declines45/improves17; HD95 worsens34/improves20/ties8. Displacement-gradient RMS declines during fine refinement; scalar roughness increase alone does not explain this case. This is one observed pair, not a causal or population claim. Remaining61-state batch stays unstarted under declared sequencing; D01 remains open.
